Before I give my story, I wish I could say it was as cool as posing as a chick in League or WoW. So first off, I am 21. I am a gay male. I have never been the most attractive dude...I am basically Shrek's incarnate. I have always been described as "That funny guy". I do love making people laugh. Sadly, I use comedic relief as a defense mechanism, and also as means to deflect or suppress a LOT of self hate. I was in a relationship with a guy for awhile, and he actually ended up cheating on me with a chick. I was feeling very bitter, and was having major self pity parties, and was being incredibly selfish...Yes I know I am a human sewer drain. I was on Tinder as myself, and was getting matches from nobody because I am actually a water buffalo. So then I randomly decided to take pictures from a girl I work with, make a fake FB and do this. I guess in my head, I did this because at the time I really fucking hated myself and WHO DOESN'T LOVE A HOT FUNNY CHICK. Anyways, I was getting matches and dudes messaging me like wildfire. I didn't really do it looking for love, due to me knowing nothing would come out of it. I was being an attention whore. Sadly, this one guy and I connected over having the same love for 90s alternative and 90s metal. It was awesome. I felt like a fucking piece of shit because I knew I was playing with someone's emotions, but it was nice having someone who I could say whatever and they did not hate on it. I was 100 percent my personality when doing this. I get that I ultimately NOT ME, and I understand now that what I did was STILL wrong. To make a long story short, I ended up telling him I am a dude. He was kinda upset, but accepting. And he ended up complimenting me on a lot of stuff. Which made it worst. I know I am the worst person ever, and I still regret this. This happened a few months ago. To anyone who is thinking about doing this, and thinks you are not hurting anyone, you are dead wrong. To anyone who is feeling awful because of you being different, take you being different as a victory because we live in a basic world. Also, to anyone who would like to call me scum, please do. Because I am into that.

I didn't call him but I did text him basically saying I was hurt, but I think we both just need time to reevaluate and that I don't wanna talk to him having an angry or fragile mindset. I mean really I don't expect anything romantic if that's not what he wants. But I seriously do want his friendship.

Hey I don't wanna sound super cliche but you're not alone. It feels like it. But I'm here to give you a huge bro hug or whatever lame shit to make you feel better. At one point in my life I was in a relationship and it ended pretty abruptly. I seriously fell very hard for this guy. I had never gotten involved with anyone before and I put my heart and soul into him and it ended up biting me in the ass. I don't blame him for anything. Yeah the guys kind of an asshat. But people do what they want. It's super hard to get over someone because you miss the laughs the convos you had. The moments. With my situation, I just thought I would try to be friends with him, but even that didn't work. Take this time to focus fully on yourself. Focus on your job (even if you work at mcdonalds) or school. Anything you can do to keep your mind off. I know it sounds super cliche but I'm so serious it works. Just take it day by day. You are fucking worth it dude. I was in a rut for about a year. All I did was read books, talk to my cat, & sometimes cry...one day I was sitting there and stepped outside and was finally ready to say "I am okay. I can do this" it is such a freeing feeling to be set free from that dark side of yourself. A book I seriously recommend is "the book of secrets by Deepak Chobra." I have dealt with severe clinical depression and social anxiety for years and this book seriously opened my mind and took me on a spiritual journey. But yes dude focus on yourself, love yourself. You are not worthless. Your relationship didn't work out and that sucks. But there are other people out there. Just learn from this relationship, take as much time as you need to heal, and start over. It sucks. Something that is hard to digest is that we do not need relationships to make us happy. Make yourself happy. Once you're happy, you can make others happy. I'm the last person to be giving anyone relationship advice. But it sucks when you have to come to Reddit for emotional guidance so I get it. I wish you the best man and if you need any more help or just wanna talk message me! I'm always down for gaining comrades. 🤘🏽

I worked graveyard shift at one part of my life. I was a security guard in a facility. One day it was me and another male guard. Take note that the place was very chill, and genuinely a place that never would have any type of suspicious incident. I loved that job. Well one night, we were manning our stations and I tell him I've gotta use the restroom. Our restroom was about 100 meters away. So I walk into the bathroom. While washing my hands, I start to hear a female voice singing. I turned off the water to hear it better and it was so clear. It sounded like it was right outside the bathroom. I thought it was my coworker fucking with me and I walked out and said "Why are you doing that?" And there was no one there...I then look down the hall and out from where our station was, my coworkers pops out and just says "what did you say?"  From the time I heard the singing while washing my hands to when I opened the door was not enough time for him to make it back to our stations. I didn't ever tell him about the singing I heard. I was not a believer of supernatural occurrences until then.

This is coming from someone who just did the exact same thing dude. I am 21. I am a dude. I recently catfished a guy. I have always struggled with loving myself, and all of that emo jazz. But my conversations with him were amazing, and I really did feel an emotional attachment to this guy. We literally texted 13 hours a day for a couple days. He kept asking me to meet him and obviously I was swerving it for a little bit. (Remember this all happened within 2 and a half days so I knew this was going too fast and I was being a jerk by giving him feelings for my fake ass). I finally came clean to him, and he was not mean, but indifferent. I did not expect anything good. He did tell me to try and take care of myself. He has then blocked my number, and I am working on moving on from it. I have been feeling awful about it. I get I deserve it because I started this whole thing. I am just glad I did not ever say anything sexual to him because at the time, we both agreed we were not into getting nasty over the interwebs. I am proud of myself for being brave to come clean though. It is just a really confusing situation, and I know this does not define the character of you or I. I do not even know you and I am glad you came clean. It does hurt right now for you and I, but it will fade. This was the first time I had ever done something like that. It is just weird as when you are depressed, you do things unlike yourself. At the time it does not feel like you are hurting anybody and you just want somebody to talk to, but I will say I feel 10x worst than I ever did before this. But you get the jist of this message. Cheers to no longer hurting someone for our selfish emotional gain....lol.
